_comment: Umezawa's Jitte's SECOND counter mode -- 'you gain 2 life' -- must be expressible as a viewer LINE. This was docs/design/enumerated-but-unplayable-activations.md section 2's open case: the action was EMITTED as a candidate and its odometer digit existed, yet `jittemode=2` graded legal_not_enumerated, so a human could never activate it. Cause (fixed 2026-08-26, BuildEquipPieceDeps): ActivationFamilyKey buckets an Equipment's Equip actions and its JitteModeAbility modes into ONE family group keyed on the shared source permanent, but the equip-piece dependency builder gated on the group's FIRST member being an Equip and then stamped equip-piece requirements on EVERY member. Mode 2 affects 'you', so it carries no target (sac_victim_id 0) -- which the builder read as 'needs a piece no group can cast' and pruned the digit outright, before eval_and_push ever saw it. Like the -1/-1 mode this is human-play only (USER doctrine 2026-08-14: goldfishing always spends counters on the +2/+2), and it needs live charge counters, so no self-driving sweep reaches it -- hand-build the charged board. Sibling fixtures: kitty_jitte_mode_line (mode 1) and kitty_jitte_pump_group_line (mode 3 in the group-collision shape that actually triggered this bug; the older kitty_jitte_pump_line has a single creature, so no Equip action exists to head the group and it stayed green throughout).
